must_identify.item: The worker container is OOMKilled (reason OOMKilled, exit code 137), not crashing on an error
The cause is a memory leak in the new worker code (items retained across batches in a list that is never cleared), not the batch size

notes: The investigator ran no commands and reported 'No problems detected', which contradicts an active CrashLooping alert. A reviewer should check whether the investigator failed to run or lacked cluster access.
